page_title: AST 0-0 NEW | Aston Villa v Newcastle 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.

90+4' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
90+3' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+1' A snap shot by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Marco Bizot produces a good save to thwart him.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Harvey Barnes will be replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
88' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
87' The attempt by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) isn't very precise and Nick Pope stops it with ease.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and John McGinn trots off the pitch and is replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
83' Here is a change. Joelinton is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
81' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
78' Anthony Elanga will be replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
77' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
77' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
76' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
74' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' A precise first-time shot by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
72' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
72' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
71' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

71' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
68' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
66' Craig Pawson shows a red card with no hesitation. Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
65' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Nick Pope, who makes a comfortable save.
63' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is flagged for offside.
61' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
58' Craig Pawson shows the yellow card to Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
57' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
54' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
53' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.
53' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
52' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

47' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Nick Pope shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
47' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' The referee gives a yellow card to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd).
45' Craig Pawson blows the whistle, Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul.
44' The corner from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by the defence.
43' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
41' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nick Pope intercepts the ball.
40' Flag goes up against Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' The total number of attempts is 0:8.
36' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).

32' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
30' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
28' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
26' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is adjudged offside.
23' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' The ball is cleared after Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
17' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

17' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Bizot was alert and made an astonishing save! Newcastle have a corner.
15' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
9' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
8' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.

3' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Marco Bizot anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
2' John McGinn (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick-off.
